intent: a paper boat drifting down a flooded gutter city, macro lens, overcast melancholy

briefs.subject: A small hand-folded paper boat of grey-white newsprint, edges softened and ink slightly bleeding from the damp, drifting on shallow floodwater that has swallowed a city street gutter; wet asphalt, submerged curb lines, drifting leaves and bits of litter, blurred grey building facades and parked-car reflections in the water around it
briefs.motion: The boat drifts slowly forward with the gentle gutter current, bobbing softly and yawing a few degrees side to side; raindrops land near it, sending concentric ripples that nudge and rock the hull; the soggy paper flexes faintly with each small wave
briefs.camera: Macro lens at water level, very shallow depth of field with the boat's bow as the focal plane and the background dissolved into soft bokeh; slow lateral tracking shot gliding alongside the boat at close range, occasional subtle focus pull from the hull to raindrop ripples; 24fps cinematic character with gentle motion blur
briefs.style: Overcast melancholy; desaturated cool palette of slate greys, muted blue-greens and washed paper white; soft diffused shadowless daylight, damp matte textures, faint filmic grain, fine-art cinematic realism with a quiet, lonely mood

The motion quality is excellent, showcasing natural, fluid ripples spreading across the water's surface and a gentle, organic rocking motion of the boat that simulates a light breeze or raindrops.
